additional_info.subject: Requester says-
additional_info.body:
Hello, After making a selection on the card reader screen, the screen keeps loading endlessly and then returns to the homescreen.
In July, until the 24th, there were CCV transactions. After that there have been none.
Indeed, in the logs and transactions, nothing is shown after 24/07.
The site owner confirms that the payment terminal worked for a
while after the maintenance, then broke down.
TID: 40800807
